#!/bin/bash

# Define Variables
PROJECT="folia"
LOCAL="/mnt/server"

# Create Local
mkdir -p "$LOCAL"
cd "$LOCAL"

# Find Latest Version
if [ "$VERSION" = "latest" ]; then 
	echo -e "searching for latest version\n"
	VERSION=`curl -s https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/folia/versions | jq -r ".versions[0].version.id"`
fi

echo -e "VARIABLES\n PROJECT: $PROJECT\n VERSION: $VERSION\n LOCAL: $LOCAL\n"

echo -e "requesting version $VERSION\n"

# Generate Links
API_LINK="https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/$PROJECT/versions/$VERSION/builds/latest"
echo -e "API LINK\n $API_LINK\n"

DOWNLOAD_LINK=`curl -s "$API_LINK" | jq -r '.downloads."server:default".url'`
echo -e "DOWLOAD LINK\n $DOWNLOAD_LINK\n"

# Validate Links
if [ "$DOWNLOAD_LINK" = "null" ]; then
	echo -e "specified link was invalid now terminating\n"
	exit
fi

echo -e "downloading server jar\n"

# Download Server Jar
curl -s "$DOWNLOAD_LINK" -o server.jar
